title: Create a message template
description: Write and submit a new WhatsApp message template for approval
examplePhrases: how do I create a template
I need a new WhatsApp template

steps.title: Go to Templates
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Templates page from the sidebar.

steps.title: Create a new template
steps.instruction: Click '+ Create Template' to open the template editor.

steps.title: Enter a template name
steps.instruction: Give your template a clear name so you can find it later.

steps.title: Write the template body
steps.instruction: Write your message. Use {{1}}, {{2}} for personalised fields like the customer's name.

steps.title: Save and submit
steps.instruction: Click Save to submit your template to WhatsApp for approval. It usually takes a few hours.
